name: Statistical-Arbitrage-Pairs-Trading
license: MIT License; actual LICENSE says Copyright (c) 2026 Niraj Neupane and requires the copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
methods: OLS hedge ratio with intercept on supplied log-price series; residual ADF with AIC autolag and a 0.05 threshold
Pair screen: log-price correlation filter (source default 0.80; pair-selection notebook 0.85), residual-stationarity result, and AR(1) half-life between zero and 60 days
60-bar rolling spread Z-score with entry at ±2, exit at ±0.5, and stop at absolute 4
Static hedge ratio, 60-bar rolling OLS hedge ratio, and experimental scalar Kalman beta with delta=1e-5 and Ve=0.001
Daily-close paper backtest using prior-bar signal, static beta, and a 5 bp per signal-change cost default
Kelly fraction and standard return/drawdown performance summaries
reuseDecision: Implement independently in TypeScript as a paper-only, out-of-sample Pairs Research layer. Do not port the Python modules or reuse bundled data/results. MIT permits code reuse with retained notice, but independent implementation avoids expression/dependency mismatch and is preferred. Add formation/trading blocks, Benjamini-Hochberg correction for universe scans, optional Johansen confirmation, explicit cost/borrow scenarios, and diagnostic provenance; do not add broker orders or fills.
requirements: Two legally usable, timestamp-aligned, corporate-action-adjusted price histories; asset metadata and owner-set paper cost/borrow assumptions
No repository market-data API, credential, provider registration, or paid plan exists: its complete current tree has bundled CSVs and no acquisition code

No additional paid data is technically required if Zax uses existing entitled data or owner-imported files; a broader recurring equity universe may require a separately licensed adjusted-history feed, and point-in-time constituents/delistings may require paid access
Use next-bar paper execution, non-overlapping 252-bar formation and 63-bar trading blocks, and persist tested-pair family size, raw p-values and q-values
If GitHub REST metadata is ever queried for this public repository, unauthenticated traffic is limited by GitHub to 60 requests per hour per originating IP; it should not be a Zax runtime dependency
